description: Ash-saturated Lake Michigan, curving lakeshore road, abandoned cars, gray ruined Chicago skyline, suspended ash, gray overcast sky.
Jason and Amanda in Box left foreground; high choppy water and white foam flood the threshold; damaged Chicago skyline including John Hancock Center rises from water under gray clouds.
Sunny street-level city, pedestrians, railings, old low brick buildings mixed with ultramodern glass towers, slender white/gold spires, planted vertical terraces, high skybridge.

Two small walking figures; brick house buried up to its upper floor by massive sculpted drifts, distant skyline, frozen lake and broken ice, diffuse blue winter light. Original contains black letterbox borders and FOLKS mark.

Very wide frozen Chicago lakeshore: jagged ice blocks and ridges to the left, long shoreline into distance, deep wind-shaped snowdrifts against city towers, low-contrast cloudy pale-blue sky. Original contains black letterbox borders and FOLKS mark.

Jason and Amanda seated in green lakeside park looking across water toward ideal Chicago: fantastically slender central towers, integrated historic Chicago buildings, rounded glass structures by shore, bright clear blue sky. Original contains black letterbox borders and FOLKS mark.
